messages:
Maria: Heads-up — PR #7831 is blocking the hotfix cutover. It's a small db compatibility tweak but we need two approvals before the 18:00 PST freeze or we'll miss the window. https://github.com/redwood-inference/repo/pull/7831
Jason: Looking now. CI shows one flaky integration failing on migrations, heading into the runner logs. Sam, did you catch that earlier? :eyes:
Sam: saw a failure on the fk-check in staging this morning, intermittent. I'm rerunning the pipeline now.
Priya: Can you paste the migration diff here? I can do a quick security/compat review and fast-approve if it's non-blocking.
Maria: snippet below — migration is guarded by a feature flag so should be safe for rollout:
```
ALTER TABLE model_runs ADD COLUMN compat_flag BOOLEAN DEFAULT FALSE;
-- migration guarded by feature flag and backfilled lazily
```
Maria: also added a short check to avoid touching rows for older model versions.
Sam: rerun passed :white_check_mark: no more fk failures on the job.
Jason: I ran a quick smoke against the staging snapshot branch — no regressions observed, latency OK. Pushed a tiny comment in the PR about a log message.
Priya: reading now… looks fine. The migration is additive and guarded. Two minor nits (naming + comment) but non-blocking. LGTM :shipit:
Jason: LGTM as well after rerun :+1: will add formal review approval on GitHub.
Lina: pinging release leads in case anything infra-related pops up — looks good from eng side :eyes:
deploy-bot: Release window check: capacity available in us-west-2, no conflicting deploys. Preflight checks OK.
Maria: great — thanks everyone. Cutting the hotfix in ~15m to hit 18:00 PST. If anything blocks, call it out here ASAP.
